liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Space** (1 review): The transition from the jam to Space after Not Fade Away is described as mind-bending [6]
- **Jam** (1 review): Track 5 on the first disc features a jam reminiscent of Phish's Possum [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Jam**: cut on the recording [15]
- **Passenger noodling**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Good Lovin' intro practice**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **it's hard to forget**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **I Need a Miracle**: cut on the recording [15]
- **Jam**: cut on the recording [15]
- **Jam**: cut on the recording [15]
- **Scarlet Begonias**: cut on the recording [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-04-16.157228.sbd.gems.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 29 songs; 164 min [1]
- **gd79-04-16.studio.clugston.3121.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 164 min; rated 3.95/5 by 20 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound quality varies but is overall very good, standing out among studio rehearsal recordings; Bobby sounds great, while the drummers are characterized as sounding sloppy [4][7]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Bertha [1]
- Jerry explains vocal harmonies to Brent, who otherwise knows the songs well [5]
- Brent adds Hammond organ color during the basic arrangement of the opening song [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-04-16.157228.sbd.gems.flac1648**: transferred by Speed Correction by Jason Chastain 2022 DAT Transfer and Mastering by Jim Blackwood Track, FLAC, and Pack by Steve Gravel; source: Master Cassette > DAT at 16/48 (with possible extra cassette generation) [1]
- **gd79-04-16.studio.clugston.3121.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Possibly the first available recording featuring Brent with the band, following Keith's departure; Master Soundboard Cassette transferred through DAT and CDR, mastered by Scott Clugston [2][3]
